name: wiki-markdown
description: Markdown-backed AI-native durable-context provider with proactive recall, approval-gated capture proposals, and agent policy scaffolding.

interface.shortDescription: Manage an AI-native project wiki backed by markdown files.
interface.longDescription: Provides a cross-plugin durable-context contract over a markdown-backed wiki under wiki/: proactively recalls relevant intent, decisions, lessons, and current state; groups durable capture candidates at semantic milestones; and writes only with configured authority. It also initializes, reads, writes, retires, completes/reopens, validates, and scaffolds concise auto-loaded policy blocks into CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md without writing operating policy into consumer wiki vaults.
defaultPrompt: Use $wiki proactively when substantive work or discussion could depend on prior intent, decisions, lessons, or current state; recall the relevant scope once and reuse it.
At a semantic milestone, deduplicate durable candidates and make one grouped capture proposal; write only after configured authority is satisfied.
For a concrete runtime defect, inspect code and runtime evidence first instead of repeatedly recalling the wiki.
Use $wiki to capture this decision and refresh indexes.
Use $agent-policy to scaffold Claude/Codex operating policy files.
